rules.statement: Where, in an application for probate of a Will, the testamentary capacity or disposing mind of the testator at the time of the execution of the Will is called in question, the onus lies on those propounding the Will to affirm positively the testamentary capacity, even in the absence of a plea of undue influence or fraud.
